edges: White produced the novel to fulfill a promise to Benham.
Benham's mother left his father for a wealthy man named Nolan.
Benham left Amanda behind in England to travel the world.
Benham was fatally shot in Johannesburg while attempting to stop soldiers firing at strikers.
Benham had conflicts with his friend Prothero.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Nolan left a large fortune to Mrs. Benham and her son.
